outline: The course focuses on processor design, pipelining, superscalar, caches (memory hierarchies), virtual memory, storage systems, and simulation techniques. Advanced topics include a survey of parallel architectures, embedded systems, and future directions in computer architecture.
schedule:
Week 1(2/21). Introduction/Performance
Week 2(2/28). Holiday
Week 3(3/7). Pipelining
Week 4(3/14). Dynamic Instruction-Level Parallelism (I)
Week 5(3/21). Dynamic Instruction-Level Parallelism (II)
Week 6(3/28). Dynamic Instruction-Level Parallelism (III)
Week 7(4/4). Static Instruction-Level Parallelism
Week 8(4/11). Multithreading/Multicore
Week 9(4/18). Midterm
Week 10(4/25). Cache/Memory (I)
Week 11(5/2). Cache/Memory (II)
Week 12(5/9). Storage Systems
Week 13(5/16). Fault Tolerance
Week 14(5/23). Virtual Machines/Cloud Computing
Week 15(5/30). Graphics processing unit
Week 16(6/6). Holiday
Week 17(6/13). Term Paper Presentation
Week 18(6/20). Final Term
assessment:
Midterm- 30%
Final- 30%
Term Paper (with an Oral Presentation) - 30%
Class Participation - 10%
